Who we are

Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.

About the team

The AI Engineering team builds the systems and capabilities behind Typeform’s AI products, including Research Flow, our platform for combining quantitative research with deeper qualitative insights.

We use machine learning, large language models, RAG, and agentic systems to help customers collect, understand, and act on information in more conversational and personalised ways.

Through Research Flow, this includes helping customers design studies, run AI-moderated conversations with adaptive follow-up questions, and turn responses into useful insights.

The team owns the journey from experimentation through to production. This includes AI application development, evaluation, infrastructure, deployment, observability, reliability, and performance.

You will work closely with Product Managers, Software Engineers, Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Analytics teams to turn promising AI ideas into secure, scalable, and dependable customer experiences.

About the role

As a Senior AI Engineer at Typeform, you will be instrumental in building and evolving the AI capabilities behind Research Flow, alongside our broader AI products.

Your work will help customers understand the “why” behind responses and move from research questions to informed decisions faster.

Your scope will span generative AI applications, enterprise RAG systems, agentic workflows, model evaluation, machine learning pipelines, and the infrastructure required to run them reliably at scale.

This is a hands-on engineering role with strong ownership. You will turn ideas and prototypes into production systems used by our customers, with direct influence on their quality and performance. You will also help define the technical standards for developing, evaluating, deploying, and monitoring AI across Typeform.

Things you will do

Build and deliver AI products

• Design, build, and deploy generative AI capabilities across Typeform’s products, with a key contribution to Research Flow.

• Develop applications using large language models, RAG, vector search, and agentic systems.

• Build services and APIs that allow product teams to integrate AI capabilities into customer experiences.

• Turn prototypes into reliable production systems with clear measures of performance and quality.

• Explore new ways for customers to collect, understand, and act on information using AI.

Build scalable AI systems

• Design and operate machine learning services and workflows using Python, Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS.

• Build reliable pipelines for batch and real time processing using technologies such as Kafka and Airflow.

• Design solutions using vector databases to support retrieval, recommendations, personalisation, and semantic search.

• Use MLflow to manage experiments, model versions, registries, and deployments.

• Improve the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost efficiency of our AI systems.

Evaluate and improve AI quality

• Evaluate retrieval strategies, including chunking, embeddings, context selection, and reranking.

• Monitor AI systems in production and identify opportunities to improve their quality and performance.

• Create safeguards that reduce unexpected behaviour and protect customer data.

Shape our AI engineering practice

• Establish reusable patterns and technical standards for building, evaluating, and releasing AI systems.

• Help teams make informed decisions about models, frameworks, infrastructure, performance, and cost.

• Apply strong engineering practices across testing, security, observability, version control, and deployment.

• Share technical knowledge and support the development of other engineers.

• Keep up with relevant AI research, tools, and engineering practices, applying what is useful to Typeform.

Collaborate across Typeform

• Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Data Engineering, and Analytics teams to connect AI investments with customer and business needs.

• Work with Data Scientists to turn experiments and models into reliable production services.

• Communicate technical concepts, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to technical and nontechnical partners.

Chargebee is a leading provider of billing and monetization solutions, empowering businesses with recurring revenue models to streamline revenue and finance operations, capture actionable insights, and drive growth.

About the Team
Chargebee's Platform Product & Engineering teams are responsible for ensuring our technical platform and infrastructure meets the expectations of businesses who rely on Chargebee to run their most important revenue operations. These businesses depend on our technical platform to be robust, extensible, performant, reliable, stable, secure and scalable in order to process billions of dollars (and Euros, and other currencies) worth of transactions with enterprise-class service levels. Our Platform Product Managers make sure we consistently meet and exceed what merchants expect of our technical platform, working closely with engineering and technical and non-technical operations teams to do so.

About the role (Job Summary)
As a member of the platform product team, you will support our ongoing strategic focus on modernizing our platform — a series of initiatives in which we are investing significant resources. We're building a microservice architecture that powers a series of loosely-coupled capabilities used across Chargebee's product lines. Our modernized platform will support throughputs an order of magnitude higher than our legacy platform, with lower latency and higher service levels and will be built to enable rapid development cycles with built-in trust and integrity controls. The modernized platform runs on a standardized and abstract cloud fabric. In addition to runtime transactional components, the modernized platform will also include enterprise data management (including data science and machine learning applications), observability and analytical, and developer productivity components.

What you'll do (role and responsibilities)
Drive planning and prioritization for your feature area within a platform domain, define and track key metrics, and work closely with engineers to define feature functionality and execute against the roadmap.
• You'll focus on one or more of the following domains: APIs (endpoints & contracts, workflows, orchestration, frameworks and infrastructure); core platform services (including IAM, queue and job management, auditing, search, notifications, etc.) and service frameworks; transactional data management, enterprise data, DS/ML, and analytical systems; cloud fabric (containers, compute, storage, etc.); path-to-production (build, quality, release gates, automated testing and validation, deployment); observability, telemetry, proactive platform health management and incident processes; and platform initiatives (security, privacy/data protection; technical standards and governance and SLAs/SLOs).

• Conduct technical product discovery at the feature level: understand customer needs (internal and external) and technical constraints well enough to write sound requirements and make day-to-day prioritization calls.
• Create detailed product requirements and acceptance criteria (within Agile Kanban or Scrum processes); manage your portion of the roadmap; prioritize within your assigned feature area.
• Working with an analytics partner, track the input and output metrics (technical and business) relevant to your feature area and report on progress.
• Working with a program management partner, follow operational processes and support staged, incremental roll-out plans.
• Help uphold SLAs and SLOs relevant to your feature area.
• Operate with growing autonomy within a matrix environment; escalate and help resolve blockers, and build strong working relationships across engineering, program management, and operations.

• Domain-appropriate knowledge: e.g., APIs (REST, GraphQL, etc.); streaming, OLTP and OLAP data systems; service frameworks; CI/CD, etc. (You are not expected to have full domain depth on day one; you should be a fast learner.)
• Foundational systems thinking: ability to understand how the parts of a technical system fit together at the feature/service level, with growing ability to reason at a broader system level.
• Background in platform product management with 5-8+ years of practical experience.
• Strong written and oral communication skills; ability to listen and understand what drives people.

• Solid critical thinking, problem-solving, and analytical skills.

• Experience or demonstrated ability collaborating with cross-functional teams outside your reporting line.
• Past experience as a software developer or SDET, or equivalent technical exposure, is a plus.
• Higher education in a technical field (CS, EE, Information Systems) or equivalent experience.

Benefits we offer
At Chargebee, we believe that feeling supported is the foundation for doing great work. We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your personal, financial, and professional growth and ensure you thrive in every aspect of your life. Our commitment to supporting our employees is universal, while our benefits are thoughtfully designed to meet the unique needs of each region. We offer comprehensive packages that generally include:
